meta.title: Newton County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Newton County's 2026 budget: one appropriation ordinance form for each office or fund, filled in by hand and filed on December 30, 2025, plus two typed summary ordinances passed December 3, 2025. We use the 'maximum appropriated amounts' on each form. The county prints a $2,400,000.00 General Fund total and a $3,881,734.80 total for its other funds.

nodes.name: Collector's Automation
nodes.note: Printed total is $77,100.00; the categories written on the form add to $67,100.00. The summary ordinance (p. 48) also lists $77,100.00.

nodes.name: Circuit Court Juvenile Div/Probate
nodes.note: The form shows $18,980.00 with $21,980.00 written above it; the summary ordinance (p. 48) lists $21,980.00, so we use that. The categories written on the form add to $18,980.00.
